_comment: Single source for every number this repository states in public.
Before August 2026 each surface carried its own copy and they drifted:
the Academy stood at 21 tools in three files and 23 in three others, and
nobody could say which was true. tests/validate-facts.mjs now holds every
listed surface against this file, so a wrong number is a red test and not
Rule: a number goes in here first, then into the surfaces. Never the
other way around. Each entry says how it was measured, so the next person
can repeat the measurement instead of trusting the file.

crew.measuredHow: persona registry on crew.studiomeyer.io. The tool count moves between releases and is deliberately not pinned anywhere.

academy.measuredHow: npx -y mcp-academy@latest, tools/list over stdio. Without ACADEMY_API_KEY the server returns 12 public tools; the key adds 9 account tools. The figure 23 that stood on three surfaces was never true for either case.

forbiddenNumbers._comment: Numbers that were wrong on a public surface. They must not come back. Each carries the file where it was found and what it should have been. SUBMISSIONS.md and scripts/ count as public: their text is copy-pasted into third-party listings, which is the worst place for a stale number because we cannot edit it afterwards.
